project.name: Text to CAE CalculiX Cantilever
project.prompt: Simulate a steel cantilever beam clamped at one end and transversely loaded at the other using the open-source CalculiX solver.

connection.message: CalculiX solved the .inp deck and the .dat results were exported to result_mesh.json.

value.en: 120 mm long square bar, 8 x 8 mm cross-section
value.zh: 120 mm 长方钢梁，截面 8 x 8 mm

value.en: Root face clamped (ENCASTRE); tip face 100 N total in -Z
value.zh: 根部端面固支（ENCASTRE）；端部 -Z 向总载 100 N

value.en: C3D8 hexahedral solid elements, 24 x 4 x 4 (384 elements)
value.zh: C3D8 六面体单元，24 x 4 x 4（384 个单元）

loads.description: Root face (x = 0) fully clamped; tip face (x = L) loaded -Z, 100 N total (4 N per tip node)

workflow.detail: Map the request to a clamped steel square bar, tip transverse load, linear static step.
Generate cantilever.inp (nodes, C3D8 hexahedra, solid section, material, BC, *NODE/*EL PRINT + *NODE/*EL FILE).
Run ccx -i cantilever; success judged by no *ERROR in stdout and a data row in the .sta (ccx exit code is untrusted).
Parse the .dat for displacement (per node) and von Mises (per element); merge with the .inp topology into result_mesh.json for the viewer.
